Americas.headline: Haiti — Record Food Insecurity Escalates
Americas.body: Analysis from the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification warns that acute hunger in Haiti is continuing to rise toward record levels, with an estimated 6.35 million people projected to face acute food insecurity. According to World Food Programme alerts, fragile food security gains are unravelling due to widespread gang violence, severe economic instability, poor agricultural yields, population displacement, and adverse climate impacts linked to El Niño.
verified_figures: 6.35 million people facing acute food insecurity

Americas.headline: Haiti — Foreign Troop Deployment and Police Expansion Amid Gang Crisis
Americas.body: El Salvador deployed over 2,000 heavily armed troops to Port-au-Prince following the abduction of four Salvadoran members of an international force by local gangs. The deployment marks one of the largest bilateral military operations in the country. In a parallel effort to address the severe security crisis, the Haitian National Police graduated 1,189 new officers on 30 October. The new class is part of a United States-funded program that aims to add 4,000 officers to the force by spring 2027.

Americas.headline: United States — New International Travel Screening for Ebola
Americas.body: The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced a mandatory rule requiring all international air passengers entering the United States to sign an attestation confirming they have not visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the past 21 days. Taking effect on 3 November, the measure comes in response to an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC that has resulted in over 10,200 confirmed cases and nearly 5,000 reported fatalities.

Africa.headline: As aid situation worsens, displaced Sudanese worry about warnings of famine
Africa.body: The sound of gunfire forced 50-year-old Aisha Adam to flee her home in the al-Kalakla neighbourhood of Khartoum days after war erupted in Sudan between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on April 15, 2023. She went to the neighbouring city of Omdurman, but fighting followed her and in May 2023, Adam had to find a new refuge. It brought her to a camp for internally displaced people (IDPs) in Port Sudan, on the country’s Red Sea coast, where she lives with her orphaned grandson and nephew.

Africa.headline: Congo Ebola outbreak death toll passes 5,000 with no vaccine for the Bundibugyo virus
Africa.body: Doctors in Congo are now treating 10,351 Ebola patients as the death toll from the current outbreak has passed 5,000. As reported by UNILAD, the Congolese Ministry of Health says 5,026 people have died, putting the lethality rate at nearly 50 percent. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, is now the second deadliest Ebola outbreak in history. It is surpassed only by the 2014 to 2016 West Africa outbreak, which claimed 11,000 lives. Concerns are rising about the authorities’ ability to contain the virus, which has continued to spread since the outbreak was declared in May. Asia-Pacific.headline: Displaced and unrecognised: Myanmar’s wounded refugees in India battle disability
Asia-Pacific.body: It was a bright and sunny day in February this year, and Liani was cooking in the kitchen when she heard a loud sound go off – the junta had dropped a bomb in her village in the Matupi township in Chin State. Before she knew it, the explosion had reached her, and shrapnel tore through her foot. She lost her right leg from the thigh down. On October 28, Liani was wheeled into the Adventist Hospital in Aizawl at 8:40 am by two of her sons. She had come for an operation to remove the fragments still lodged in her left foot.

Asia-Pacific.headline: India makes Air Suvidha form mandatory for all international arrivals amid Ebola outbreak
Asia-Pacific.body: All international passengers arriving in India must now complete the mandatory Air Suvidha Self-Declaration Form (SDF) before their journey, amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak. Passengers have been advised to complete the online form before starting their journey to India and provide all mandatory information accurately. The information will help immigration and health authorities identify passengers who may require additional medical assessment or assistance after arrival.
